create_EmptySpace: create an EmptySpace gym Space that always samples None for actions without arguments
create_ActionSpace: create an ActionSpace with a dict of named actions and their argument gym Spaces
sample_ActionSpace: sample a random action and its arguments from an ActionSpace instance
create_ListSpace: create a ListSpace gym Space for variable-length sequences of token ids or vectors
contains_ListSpace: check if a list of elements is contained within a ListSpace with min and max length bounds
